translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Yesu doniki kwaune Yelusalema againe giyemu.
Yesu ana tomuliya buye Yelusalema hiꞋivedaꞋufona tu melala luhei Bedefegi kadu Bedani oya Olive againe hiyemu. Medede againe hiyemu tu ana tomuliya adiꞋiselu gigahedi be wai hinanagona.

Gigahedi gigayo, “Omi wai wananagona yuwa melala againe wanaluku, ada wanalukuluku tu doniki natudi ai againe hiluhifona-ma wanamaduꞋitana. Mena doniki kwaune keke tamo hakwadi boi gidayage. Au wanayauna be wanaꞋaliyena.
Ada kaꞋi tamo hakwadi ginagahe ginagayo, Gavana faꞋina wayauyauni? au wanagahena wanagayo, Yama Kaiwabu nuwanuwana meꞋama ada aimo tova kabiꞋona ginaveleyewemi.
Au tomuliya adiꞋiselu hina doniki natudi manuwa edaꞋawaneya gava melaleya hiluhifona-ma hinuhagana, ada au hiyauna.
Ada badi tolauboda medede againe himidimidi-ma higahedi higayo, Gavadi wagagauga? Gavana faꞋina doniki natudi wayauyauni?”
Ada Yesu gigahe amine higahedi, ada au hihawahegedi be hina.
Au doniki natudi Yesu againe hiꞋaliyena, adi aikeva kwaune hiyavelina be Bana giyage.
Ada kaliva moyaꞋaidi yoꞋo agaidiya adi aikeva edeya hiyaveyavelina, kadu tufoidi ai laganina walukulukumina faheya hikuyana-ma edeya hiyaveyavelina.
Ada kaliva tufoidi wai hinagona tufoidi wai himulina, ada Yesu buye hinauna tu hikovakova higayo,

content.text: Kaiwabu ana eganeya uꞋelaꞋela-ma au Yaubada ginanuwakabubuye.
Tuwai-moꞋena bwaneneda Devida yoꞋo moyaꞋaidi givehimeyedi amine,

content: Ada Yesu Yelusalema againe gilakayemu gina manuwa-tafalolo lakahina againe giluku ada gaitoma moyaꞋaina gilumatavilena. Kadu gihobu ada mala ahe gilavina faꞋina yana yoꞋo tuwelo buye Bedani againe hina.
Yesu ai ana egana fiki giꞋalatabutabuyena.
Bogi hida mala gilauna Bedani againe hitauya Yelusalema againe hinauna tu Yesu mafu gilauna.
Yuwa lauveya ai ana egana fiki walukulukumina giꞋita-yo gina be kaꞋi tamo guwana gisena-ma ginaꞋitana. GidaꞋita ma lukuminaga gidauda, faꞋina medema keke fiki yana tova yoyo.
Au ai againe gigahe gigayo, “Aimo tova mulina kadu keke unayoyo be kaliva guwa ginaꞋani, keke-moꞋa.” Hidedemi Yesu ai giꞋalatabutabuyena tu tomuliya hinogalina.
Yesu manuwa-tafalolo lakahina againe giluku.

Hinauna tu Yelusalema againe hilakayemu, au Yesu manuwa-tafalolo lakahina ana edaꞋawaneya giluku givebutu badi mene manuwa-tafalolo againe hilukimokimone-ma giwavidi, mani tulina tulina ana tosenisi yadi tolama givetalaꞋafufuna kadu kaliva bunebune abaveyao faꞋina hikimonevedamanedi-ma yadi abavetoga gituwabwatavilana.
Ada kaliva moyaꞋaidi gihawatadi be keke tamo lokoloko kimone faꞋina manuwa-tafalolo ana edaꞋawaneya hinaselukuweni.
Au givebutu yoꞋo givehawaledi gigayo, “Yaubada bonana etoꞋetoladina gavaimi gigahe ma maꞋi wahalamanena o kaꞋi keke? Gigayo,

content.text: Yaku manuwa hinavewagana abaveꞋoveꞋoꞋola ana manuwa yoꞋo tulina tulina faꞋidiya.

content: Tu omiꞋiyao ma vaita tokaiꞋafu yadi abaga amine wafaisewana.” Hidede amine Yesu gidakeyedi.

Tu badi abaveyao ana tofaisewa kikaiwabudiyao kadu Mosese yana vehimeya ana tovehawala Yesu yana dakeya hinogalina, au himatausena faꞋina hivebutu eda hilelena be higa hinaluveꞋalikana. Kaliva moyaꞋaidi Yesu yana vehawala nuwadi giꞋabina be hiyaulowoga faꞋina, mena kaliva kikaiwabudiyao Yesu himatausena.
Ada au mala gisilavina Yesu ana tomuliya buye hilowoga be Yelusalema hihegena.
Yesu vetumagana be veꞋoꞋola faꞋina givehawala.
Bogi hida mala gilauna kadu hitauya ada edeya hinauna tu ai ana egana fiki hiꞋitana, ai lukumina matatabuna giꞋawaꞋulona tu walamina giwelolona.
Fita nuwana giꞋafolena ada Yesu againe gigahe gigayo, “Tovehawala uꞋita. Fiki uꞋalatabutabuyena-ma a giꞋawaꞋulona.”
Yesu gigahedi gigayo, “Yami vetumagana Yaubada againe wanasena.

Gagahe velemoꞋena hai kaliva ginavetumaganadona, medema hida oya againe anafaiweya ginagahe ginagayo, Una lehageya utowa. KaꞋi aseꞋasena keke ginaꞋamalakibo tu ginavetumagana vaita gavaimi gigahe amine ginalakayemu velemoꞋena, au givetumagana amine ginanuhagana.
Yami vetumagana amine wananuhagana faꞋina kadu ganagahe. Gavadi gavadi faꞋina waveꞋoꞋola, wanavetumagana be higa vaita medema ahe wavaina, ada au gavadi faꞋina waveꞋoꞋola-ma wananuhagana.
WaveꞋoꞋola tova, kaꞋi tamo hakwadi omi agaimiya gikoyo, au yana koyona wanavenuwauluyena be higa Tamami lobameya gimimiyami-ma kadu yami koyona ginavenuwauluyena. [
Atu kaꞋi omi tobohiyamiyao yadi koyona keke wanavenuwauluyeni, kadu keke Tamami lobameya gimimiyami-ma yami koyona ginavenuwauluyeni.] ”
Yesu yana abavehimeya inubana faꞋina hitoliluveluvena.

Tu Yesu ana tomuliya buye Yelusalema againe kadu hilakayemu. Ada Yesu manuwa-tafalolo lakahina ana edaꞋawaneya ginunudadana tu abaveyao ana tofaisewa kikaiwabudiyao kadu Mosese yana vehimeya ana tovehawala kadu kaliva lakahidiyao Bana againe hiꞋela.

Ada hitoliluveluvena higayo, “O ugahema, haꞋagaine ya abavehimeya uvaini-yo mena gaitoma tulina tulina boiyesedi hidei manuwa-tafalolo lakahina againe ufifaisewadi? HakwaꞋadi mena abavehimeya givele-yo hidedemi uhuluva?”
Yesu gigayo, “Yaku toliluvaluva saꞋeyana omi agaimiya ganasena. KaꞋi bonaku wanafatana amine o yaku abavehimeya inubana faꞋina ganavenuwaꞋatami.
HakwaꞋadi abavehimeya Yoni Tobafitaiso givele-yo kaliva gikivebafitaisoyedi? KaꞋi yana abavehimeya Yaubada againe giveꞋinuba o kaꞋi kaliva agaidiya? Bonaku wafata.”

Yesu gigahe-yo badi hivebutu buye hivekwageya higayo, “KaꞋi kanagahe vaita Yoni yana abavehimeya Yaubada againe gidaveꞋinuba au Bana ginagahe ginagayo, KaꞋi Yaubada againe digo, gavadi-yo Yoni yana gahe keke wadavetumaganeni?
Tu kaꞋi kanagahe vaita kaliva agaidiya gidaveꞋinuba....” A! Mema yoꞋo himatausedi higa vaita gavaimi hinakivekoyodi, faꞋina moyaꞋaidi hinuwanuwa vaita Yoni Yaubada bonana ana toꞋawatalatalaina.

Hidedemi tonagona hinuwanuwa faꞋina Yesu yana toliluvaluva hidede amine hifatana higayo, “KaꞋiwa. Ime keke adahalamaneni.” Ada Yesu gigayo, “Omi keke wadagaheku faꞋina, meda anafaiweya Iya keke ganavenuwaꞋatami hadeꞋagaine yaku abavehimeya giveꞋinuba-yo hida gaitoma gafifaisewani.” Hidede amine Yesu miYuda adi tonagona agaidiya gigahe.
